authority: Women Entrepreneurship Platform (WEP), NITI Aayog-originated ecosystem platform
interpretation: This packet records current first-party observations for reviewer use. WEP is a discovery, matching and ecosystem platform, not a direct grant, loan, investment, certification or government filing entitlement. WEP-listed programmes retain their own authority, eligibility, terms and application route.
sourcePolicy: WEP is useful for discovery and ecosystem-service evidence. The underlying Government scheme source remains the publishing authority for any scheme record. WEP partner and knowledge-portal content must be labelled and independently verified before UdyamVeda publishes it as an opportunity.

supportingSources.anchor: Current WEP discovery portal: government schemes, access to finance, incubators and accelerators, mentoring/networking, market linkages and business-development resources; registration/full-access and smart-match entry points.
Current access-to-finance page: government-scheme, financial-institution, state-scheme and knowledge-bank categories, with partner/resource content and Smart Match.

Current individual mentorship route: women entrepreneurs and women-led collective enterprises may join as mentees; profile inputs include industry, stage, location, language, ecosystem need and engagement mode; no sensitive information should be shared with mentors.
Current mentorship code: mentors volunteer on a pro-bono basis, must follow conduct expectations and cannot be treated as government-appointed advisors or guaranteed service providers.

Current disclaimer: WEP/CII-Yi knowledge content is general information, may include external sources, is not a warranty of completeness or accuracy, and users should verify details with the respective authorities.
NITI Aayog Annual Report 2022-23: WEP described as a unified-access aggregator and knowledge hub addressing information asymmetry for women entrepreneurship.

records.sourceAnchor: WEP current knowledge/access-to-finance/mentorship pages and disclaimer; NITI Aayog annual-report description
observations: WEP currently presents discovery categories covering funding, incubation and acceleration, mentoring and networking, market linkages, business-development services, schemes, incubators, publications and videos. A category or listing is not itself a Government benefit entitlement.

The access-to-finance page contains Government schemes, financial-institution resources, State schemes and other knowledge/partner content. UdyamVeda must not inherit WEP's labels, amounts or eligibility into a canonical opportunity record without verifying the underlying authority source.

The current individual mentorship route welcomes existing and aspiring women entrepreneurs and women-led collective enterprises as mentees. Smart Match uses business stage, industry, location, language, ecosystem need and engagement mode; a match is a discovery result, not acceptance or a guaranteed mentor relationship.

WEP states that individual mentoring is free for mentees, mentees contact mentors first, and no sensitive personal information needs to be shared with mentors. These are current platform-service conditions, not a Government subsidy or cash benefit.

The mentorship guidelines describe pro-bono mentor participation and conduct boundaries, while the portal also discloses content, technology and design partners. Partner services and external listings require separate terms and due diligence.

The WEP/CII-Yi disclaimer explicitly warns that portal information may come from external sources and should be verified with the respective Government authority. This makes WEP a discovery/cross-check source in UdyamVeda's editorial hierarchy, not a standalone publishing authority for listed schemes.

Mentor and partner availability is dynamic; the current page may show no mentors or a changing resource set. UdyamVeda must not publish fixed counts, availability or acceptance promises without a dated source check.

Review partner disclosures, external listings, fees, current programme windows and authority links before showing any WEP listing as actionable.
Obtain human reviewer approval for source, eligibility, benefit, application, window, fine print, amendment, partner classification and factual accuracy before publication.

publicationGuard.reason: Current WEP pages support a non-financial ecosystem and mentorship draft, but underlying-authority mapping, partner classification, consent/privacy behavior, live availability and exact source capture remain outstanding.
